name: Upper Tier Soldier
source:
(Voiced by an unspecified actor in the FullVoice ReBorn edition)
One of the Knights protecting the Upper Tier and its laws, Genocidal Enforcers, half-enginized people who'd quit being human. 
Armor covers its entire body and something is writhing within its open helmet: disgusting, inhuman flesh.
No longer human and no Fantastic Mutant either.
(Edited from in-game text)
